DIAGNOSIS READY: Temporal Lobe Epilepsy

The EEG results showing interictal spikes and sharp waves localized to the right temporal lobe, combined with your history of unresponsiveness and facial grimacing, strongly indicate temporal lobe epilepsy. Do you recall any specific triggers for these episodes, such as flashing lights or specific smells, and have you experienced any post-episode confusion?
